originating_session_goal: Extend principle-completeness execution into every affected repository and notify dependent control planes and publication surfaces.

completed_repositories.remaining_role: Consumer-owned propagation only through already named handoffs.

bounded_non_direct_states.owner: Admissible-Existence organization or repository Actions administrator

routing_rules.source: Install or update repository handoff, principle registry, dependency graph, proof candidates, theory map, notation, falsification limits, validation evidence, and integration state.
routing_rules.support: Install or update repository handoff, support-role and non-authority boundary, source coverage map, validation/support contract, and evidence state.
routing_rules.empty: Create an explicit implementation, deprecation, or migration disposition record before closure.
routing_rules.machine_owned_observe_only: Do not duplicate implementation; notify or observe the canonical machine lane and record evidence.
routing_rules.validated_complete_notify_only: Preserve completion evidence and do not reopen source work absent a separately admitted propagation task or regression.
routing_rules.source_complete_integration_pending: Preserve source completion and continue only the named integration task.
routing_rules.implementation_complete_hosted_validatio: Preserve deterministic completion and await the named Actions-authority release condition; do not reopen implementation.
routing_rules.coordination: Maintain registry, claims, reports, routing, collision controls, and archive state.

immediate_dependencies.required_action: Activate hosted grant proof and provide sanitized exact-run receipt authority.
Resolve and deliver a runtime-only bounded capability inside the authorized TVC invocation without persistence or disclosure.

propagation_gate: No downstream propagation is claimed or executed until a repository is directly validated and a separately admitted propagation task exists.
completion_condition: All 31 non-control-plane repositories have a direct update, disposition, integration-only, hosted-validation-blocked, or observe-only completion receipt; immediate TV/TVC dependencies are validated; and every applicable downstream propagation task is completed or explicitly not applicable with evidence.
